homepageTopArticles.title: Luxury Conglomerate Richemont May Be Joining a Bid to Buy De Beers: Report
homepageTopArticles.snippet: The move would come at a time when jewelry is doing particularly well for the Cartier owner.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Richemont may join a bid to buy De Beers as jewellery performs particularly well for the Cartier owner.

homepageTopArticles.title: LVMH fashion sales fall 5% as weak Chinese demand hits flagship brand
homepageTopArticles.snippet: A slowdown among Chinese shoppers pushed the luxury group's biggest division back into decline after one quarter of growth. Selective retailing, home to Sephora, rose 8%.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: LVMH fashion sales fell 5% as Chinese demand weakened, while selective retailing, home to Sephora, grew 8%.

homepageTopArticles.title: Richemont and Signet Said In Talks to Join Bidder for De Beers
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Luxury giant Richemont and US retailer Signet Jewelers Ltd. are in talks to join a consortium that’s in prime position to buy diamond miner De Beers, according to five people familiar with the matter.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Richemont and Signet Jewelers are in talks to join a consortium in prime position to buy diamond miner De Beers.

homepageTopArticles.title: M&S ecommerce shoppers and app users can now pay with Klarna
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Shoppers on M&S.com and the M&S app can now pay with Klarna, with the three-part payment option available. Whether shopping for fashion, home or beauty, M&S customers can split the cost into three equal, interest-free payments with transparent terms and no revolving balance, according to the new partnership. Katherine Carlson, director of financial services at M&S,...
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: M&S has added Klarna to its website and app, letting shoppers split purchases into three equal, interest-free payments.
